confidence_notes: The FX figure comes from an RBA search result. That result listed 19 Nov 2026 at 0.6677 USD per AUD. Food and drink anchors come from one search of cost-of-living sites, some of them crowdsourced and undated, and the sources disagree. I found no cocktail price, so I estimated it at about 2.5x beer, and wine by the glass is also an estimate. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Palawan tourism, not from live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Philippine secondary tourist cities such as Cebu and Dumaguete, adjusted for Puerto Princesa's gateway role for El Nido and Underground River tourism.
